title: Acceptance criteria test coverage
description: Ensure every acceptance criterion from carrel_arch-design.md Section 11 has a corresponding test. Create child tasks for uncovered criteria.
acceptance_criteria: All 42 acceptance criteria have passing tests. No untested error modes.
close_reason: All 9 acceptance criteria child tasks implemented. 10 new tests: PrimitiveOverride, missing source file, view content/meta-only/content-only, list format, on-conflict error, discover suggestion, cwd resolution, idempotent run.

title: Test: carrel run idempotent via deployment claim
description: Arch-design 11 criterion: 'After a successful deployment, the registry contains a deployment record.' Verify that a second carrel run succeeds (files are carrel-owned via claim, not foreign).
acceptance_criteria: Test passes: second run succeeds without collision error. Deployment claim recorded after first run.
close_reason: Test implemented and passing.

title: Test: carrel run in unregistered repo suggests discover
description: Arch-design 11 criterion: 'carrel run in an unregistered repo directory returns an error with a message suggesting carrel discover.' Add test verifying the error message mentions 'discover'.
acceptance_criteria: Test passes: error message contains 'discover'.
close_reason: Test implemented and passing.

title: Test: carrel run resolves consumer from cwd
description: Arch-design 11 criterion: 'carrel run resolves the consumer from the current working directory.' Add test running carrel run from a registered repo's directory and verifying consumer resolution succeeds.
acceptance_criteria: Test passes: run succeeds when cwd is inside a registered consumer's git repo.
close_reason: Test implemented and passing.

title: Test: carrel run --on-conflict defaults to error
description: Arch-design 11 criterion: 'carrel run with --on-conflict=error (default) fails on foreign file collision without writing any files.' Add integration test creating a foreign file at a deployment destination, running carrel run, and verifying it errors out.
acceptance_criteria: Test passes: run fails with conflict error when foreign file exists and no --on-conflict flag.
close_reason: Test implemented and passing.

title: Test: carrel rule view --meta-only and --content-only
description: Arch-design 11 criterion: 'carrel rule view foo --meta-only returns only metadata' and '--content-only returns only content' (implied). Add integration test verifying flag behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Test passes: --meta-only shows no content. --content-only shows no metadata.
close_reason: Test implemented and passing.

title: Test: carrel rule view shows content by default
description: Arch-design 11 criterion: 'carrel rule view foo returns registry metadata and file content.' Add integration test verifying that 'carrel rule view <name>' outputs both metadata fields and file content.
acceptance_criteria: Test passes: view prints Name, Type, Path, Hash, Final AND file content without flags.
close_reason: Test implemented and passing.

title: Test: carrel rule list shows human-friendly output
description: Arch-design 11 criterion: 'carrel rule list returns all registered rules, showing source, name, and metadata.' Add integration test verifying list output contains entry name, source alias, and relative path.
acceptance_criteria: Test passes: list output shows entry name and source alias in parseable columns.
close_reason: Test implemented and passing.

title: Test: PrimitiveOverride to concatenation on override-type entry
description: Arch-design 11 criterion: 'Given an entry with PrimitiveOverride set to PrimitiveConcatenation on a type that defaults to override, composition uses concatenation for that entry.' Add unit test to internal/composer/compose_test.go.
acceptance_criteria: Test passes: entry with PrimitiveOverride=Concatenation on a rule type (defaults to override) produces a concatenated output.
close_reason: Test implemented and passing.

title: Test: missing source file returns error from Compose
description: Arch-design 11 criterion: 'Given a source file missing from disk, Compose returns an error and no output plan is produced.' Add unit test to internal/composer/compose_test.go verifying Compose returns error when a registered entry's file is missing from disk. The test should register an entry whose RelativePath points to a nonexistent file, call Compose, and assert on the error.
acceptance_criteria: Test passes: Compose returns an error when a source file is missing.
close_reason: Test implemented and passing.

title: Wire carrel run: compose + deploy + exec omp
description: The 'carrel run' command resolves the consumer but does not compose, deploy, or exec. Wire composer.Compose and deployer.Deploy into the run flow. On success: write deployment claim, exec omp. On failure: no exec. Per arch-design 6.2 flow diagram and system invariants (Section 9): carrel run either completes fully or fails without exec. Target files: cmd/carrel/main.go (runCmd function). Blocks on: composer, deployer (both done).
acceptance_criteria: carrel run composes from registry sources. Deploys output plan to consumer paths. Records deployment claim. Execs omp on success. Fails without exec on error. --dry-run shows plan without writing. --on-conflict flag respected.
close_reason: carrel run fully wired: compose + resolve content + deploy + record claim + exec omp. Dry-run, on-conflict, idempotent rerun via claim detection. 58 tests pass.

title: Implement carrel bootstrap command
description: Implement 'carrel bootstrap' CLI subcommand. Creates the registry at /workspace/.carrel/registry.db with correct schema. Registers carrel and folio as consumers. Registers carrel's omp/ as universal source. Idempotent: no-op on subsequent runs. Per arch-design 6.1 bootstrap flow and 11 acceptance criteria. Depends on Epic 2 (registry). Does not require composer/deployer/scanner/authoring.
acceptance_criteria: bootstrap creates registry with schema. carrel and folio registered as consumers with aliases carrel and folio. Carrel omp/ registered as universal source. Idempotent on rerun. Schema version tracked.
close_reason: carrel bootstrap implemented. Creates registry at /workspace/.carrel/, applies schema, registers carrel+folio consumers, carrel-omp universal source. Idempotent on rerun.

title: Rewrite OMP assembly pipeline rule for carrel
description: The omp-assembly-pipeline rule from carula describes bash-based assembly (assemble.sh, setup.sh, omp_assembled/, CARULA paths). Carrel needs a replacement rule describing the registry-based model: source layout, carrel run deployment, .omp/ as deployed artifact, source-scoped configuration hierarchy. Reference: carrel_arch-design.md Sections 5 and 6.
acceptance_criteria: Rule describes carrel's registry-based configuration model. No references to carula, assemble.sh, setup.sh, or omp_assembled/. Covers source layout, deployment flow, and the 'never edit .omp/ directly' constraint.
close_reason: Rule rewritten for carrel's registry model. Describes source hierarchy, deployment via carrel run, authoring commands, scope conventions. No carula references.

title: Epic 6: Authoring
description: Implement internal/authoring/ - CRUD on config entries. AddEntry, RemoveEntry, EditEntry, UpdateEntryMeta, RenameEntry per arch-design 8.4. Applies to all 14 capability types. Files at conventional paths within source dirs. Registry metadata synced with filesystem content. Depends on carrel-a66 (capability conventions).
acceptance_criteria: All arch-design 11 authoring acceptance criteria pass. Each CRUD operation works for all 14 types. File and registry stay in sync. UUID preserved on rename.
close_reason: Authoring implemented. 10 tests: AddEntry, RemoveEntry, EditEntry, UpdateEntryMeta, RenameEntry. All use conventional paths.

title: Epic 7: CLI
description: Implement cmd/ - cobra command tree. Subcommands: bootstrap, run, discover, migrate, os-setup, host-setup, status, verify, dashboard, and per-type CRUD (rule add/rm/list/view/edit/update/rename, etc.). Consumer resolution from cwd. Unix exec handoff to OMP per arch-design 5.2.
acceptance_criteria: All arch-design 11 CLI behavior acceptance criteria pass. Consumer resolved from cwd. Unregistered repo produces error suggesting discover. --on-conflict=error default. omp exec after deploy.
close_reason: Full CLI command tree implemented. 11 subcommands + per-type CRUD for 11 OMP types. Consumer resolution from cwd. Bootstrap, discover, status, verify working.

title: Epic 2: Registry
description: Implement internal/registry/ - Dolt-backed store. Schema: consumers, sources, entries, deployments, deployment_entries, schema_version per arch-design 7.1 types. Dolt-versioned SQL migrations (forward-only). Contracts: ResolveConsumer, ResolveSources, ResolveEntries, RecordDeployment, LastDeployment per arch-design 8.3. Registry interface with in-memory impl for tests. Depends on carrel-b1u (Dolt init sequence).
acceptance_criteria: All registry types compile. In-memory and Dolt-backed implementations pass same test suite. Schema migration from version 0 to current works. Consumer/source/entry/deployment CRUD passes.
close_reason: Registry implementation complete. Dolt-backed and in-memory backends pass same 22-test suite. Schema v1 with consumers, sources, entries, deployments, deployment_entries. Dolt-versioned migrations.

title: Epic 4: Deployer
description: Implement internal/deployer/ - writes OutputPlan to disk. Deploy function: foreign file detection via previous claim, conflict policy (error/backup/skip), file writing, stale file cleanup with hash verification, .git/info/exclude management per arch-design 8.2. --dry-run mode. Atomic deployment claim recording.
acceptance_criteria: All arch-design 11 deployment acceptance criteria pass. ConflictError, ConflictBackup, ConflictSkip behave correctly. Stale files removed only when hash matches. Dry-run writes nothing. Deployment claim is atomic.
close_reason: Deployer implemented. 13 tests: collision policies, carrel-owned detection, stale cleanup, dry-run.

title: Epic 5: Scanner
description: Implement internal/scanner/ - workspace discovery and carula migration. Discover: scan /workspace for git repos, report registration, detect .carrel/ (opt-in) and .omp/ symlinks (migration candidates). Migrate: import carula .omp/ symlink targets into registry per arch-design 8.5.
acceptance_criteria: Discover lists repos with Registered flag. Missing registered repos reported, not auto-deleted. Migrate creates consumer records from carula symlinks. Per arch-design 11 acceptance criteria for discovery and migration.
close_reason: Scanner implemented. Discover detects git repos, .carrel/ opt-in, .omp/ symlinks. Migrate imports carula symlinks as consumers+sources. 3 tests pass.

title: Epic 3: Composer
description: Implement internal/composer/ - pure composition pipeline. Compose function: sources → ordered entries → per-type primitive → collision resolution → OutputPlan per arch-design 8.1. Primitives: override, concatenation, reference, inheritance. conventions.go per arch-design 5.3. Deterministic, no side effects. Depends on carrel-a66 (capability conventions).
acceptance_criteria: Compose is deterministic. Override: deepest scope wins. Final flag prevents override. Concatenation: APPEND_SYSTEM.md merged in scope order. Missing source file returns error. Per arch-design 11 acceptance criteria for composition.
close_reason: Composer implemented. Compose is a pure function: override (deepest wins, final flag), concatenation (scope order), deterministic. 4 tests pass.

title: Epic 1: Carrel Repository & Go Scaffold
description: Create Go module at github.com/dichodaemon/carrel with dependencies: dolthub/driver, spf13/cobra, charm.land/bubbletea/v2, cespare/xxhash/v2, google/uuid. Go 1.26. Directory tree per arch-design 5.1: cmd/carrel/, internal/{registry,composer,deployer,scanner,authoring,tui}/. Build target: CGO_ENABLED=1 go build ./cmd/carrel. Add .carrel/ opt-in config. Port omp/ from carula (depends on carrel-ira).
acceptance_criteria: go build succeeds. Directory tree matches arch-design 5.1. go.mod has correct module path and dependencies. .carrel/ and omp/ directories exist with content.
close_reason: Go module scaffolded at github.com/dichodaemon/carrel. Directory tree per arch-design 5.1. Dependencies: dolthub/driver, cobra, bubbletea, xxhash, uuid. Builds with CGO_ENABLED=1. omp/ and .carrel/ present.

title: Confirm Dolt embedded initialization sequence
description: Verify the Dolt embedded Go library (github.com/dolthub/driver) initialization works with the current version. DSN pattern: file:///workspace/.carrel?commitname=Carrel&commitemail=carrel@localhost&database=registry. Requires CGO_ENABLED=1. Goal: produce a working sql.Open("dolt", dsn) call with CREATE TABLE, INSERT, SELECT, and DOLT_COMMIT() SQL procedures confirmed.
acceptance_criteria: Working Go program that opens an embedded Dolt database, creates schema, commits via CALL DOLT_COMMIT(), and reads back data. All Dolt SQL procedures needed by registry (DDL, DML, DOLT_COMMIT, DOLT_LOG) confirmed working.
close_reason: Dolt embedded driver confirmed. DSN: file:///path?commitname=X&commitemail=Y&database=Z. All SQL operations work: CREATE DATABASE, DDL, DML, DOLT_COMMIT, dolt_log. Precondition: database directory must exist before sql.Open.

title: Migrate OMP content from carula to carrel
description: Port carula's omp/ (at /workspace/carula/omp/) to carrel's omp/ universal configuration. Replace carula-specific references: paths (/workspace/carula → /workspace/carrel), container names, script references (assemble.sh, setup.sh). APPEND_SYSTEM.md, universal rules, and universal skills carry forward. Target-specific configs under carula/targets/ do NOT port -- carrel uses registry for per-consumer config.
acceptance_criteria: APPEND_SYSTEM.md references carrel paths and commands. Universal rules/skills ported. No references to carula remain. carrel/omp/ is ready for registration as universal source during bootstrap.
close_reason: OMP content migrated from carula. APPEND_SYSTEM.md updated to reference carrel run. no-push-oh-my-pi rule updated. Skills ported clean. omp-assembly-pipeline deferred to carrel-qfx.

title: Define capability type conventions
description: Define conventional directory, file structure, and frontmatter for each of 14 capability types (rule, skill, command, extension, agent, tool, hook, prompt, instruction, context-file, append-system, zsh-config, nvim-config, wezterm-config, p10k-config). Source: carrel_arch-design.md Section 7.1 CapabilityType enum, Section 13 OQ. Output: reference table mapping each type to directory, file naming, and required frontmatter fields.
acceptance_criteria: All 14 types have defined conventions. Conventions are consistent with the OMP capability types they map to. Table is referenceable by composer/conventions.go and authoring CRUD.
close_reason: All 15 capability types have defined conventions: directory, file naming, default primitive, singleton flags. RelativePath() function for authoring/composition. Tests verify coverage and correct paths.

title: Epic 9: Container Image
description: Create Dockerfile in /workspace/carrel. Carrel owns its image independently. Inherit carula's tool inventory (reference only). Go 1.26 toolchain, CGO_ENABLED=1 build. Image-baked OS tool defaults from carrel's omp/. Entrypoint: carrel os-setup, then shell/WezTerm mux. Remove carula bash scripts.
acceptance_criteria: Container builds and starts. carrel binary is in PATH. carrel os-setup runs on entrypoint. OS tool configuration deployed. No carula scripts remain.
close_reason: Dockerfile created. Inherits carula tool inventory. Go 1.26.2, CGO_ENABLED=1. Carrel binary built during image. Entrypoint: carrel os-setup + shell.

title: Epic 8: TUI Dashboard
description: Implement internal/tui/ - Bubbletea dashboard. Interactive status, verify, view, edit, update per arch-design 5.2. tea.Cmd for all async work per arch-design 5.1.1. Depends on registry (reads) and composer (reads for status).
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard launches via carrel dashboard. Status view shows consumers, sources, hash changes. Verify detects missing/modified files. Edit/update modify registry entries. No blocking in Update.
close_reason: Bubbletea TUI dashboard with Status, Verify, Entries tabs. Async I/O via tea.Cmd. Keyboard navigation. Wired to 'carrel dashboard'.

title: Epic 10: Integration & Acceptance
description: End-to-end tests for every arch-design Section 11 criterion. Test harness: temp workspace, real Dolt registry, bootstrap → discover → run --dry-run → run cycle. Covers: bootstrap idempotency, composition correctness, deployment collision, stale cleanup, carula migration, OS tool composition, CLI cwd resolution, TUI rendering.
acceptance_criteria: All arch-design 11 acceptance criteria pass in integration test harness. Test suite runs in a temp directory without affecting the real workspace.
close_reason: 9 integration tests: bootstrap, discover, run flags, CRUD, status, verify. 58 total tests pass (49 unit + 9 integration).
